3049.why: The surviving 'Russian church' of St Alexander Nevsky on Marjanishvili Street (Wikidata Q4061030); the coordinates of the Russian article are 41 m from the register point. The English article 'Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, Tiflis' is another, demolished building (1930) 1.6 km away and must not be linked.
